title: A WORD FOR THE FALLEN--ONLY GOO KNOWETH THE WHEREFORE AND WHY--ORSON
author: Orson F. Whitney
note: Published 1888. Whitney (grandson, later apostle). 68 chapters. Incorporates extensive verbatim journal extracts.

footnotes.text: This letter preceded, only by a few weeks, an epistle from Isaac Russell to the Saints in Alston, England, of a nature "calculated to deceive and lead astray."
